name: AI in Health Summer Camp (George Mason University)
org: George Mason University, Department of Health Administration and Policy
what_you_do: Each day has a short lesson, a hands-on activity and a team build session. The session is called the AI Maker Lab. You work on real health problems. The week ends with a showcase and a certificate of completion.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th and 12th grade students. No coding, health care or technology experience is required.
pay_detail: The camps list at Mason says it is a free, five day program. The camp page itself does not list a cost.
duration: 5 days, 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. each day
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 27 to 31, 2026 and applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted. The page offers a Future Programs Interest Form.
how_to_apply: Applications are closed. Fill out the Future Programs Interest Form on the camp page to get updates. Contact: Maria Uriyo, muriyo@gmu.edu.
notes: This is a day camp at George Mason University's Fairfax campus, 4400 University Drive, Fairfax, VA 22030. Not a job.
